Terms of Use

Use Sorry with Love lawfully and respectfully. You are responsible for the names and text you enter and for how you share generated experiences. Do not use the site to harass, pressure, threaten, or repeatedly contact anyone who has asked for no contact.

Use these guides as a starting point. Personalise messages honestly, respect boundaries, and avoid pressuring anyone to forgive or reply.
